name: Shinozaki Yukie
source:
(From Getchu)
The marriage of the elegant fruit, the remarriage partner of the hero's father.
Being young and graceful, he is a longing sister -like presence rather than mother-in-law.
As I usually go to the hospital with my grandfather's attendant,
Talking always comes only with a drinking party together.
